content:
olivia: Heads up - partner uploaded build artifacts publicly for ~12h. found plaintext `backup_key_secret` and several KMS ciphertexts in `artifacts/build-2026-09.zip`.
ryan: ack. do we know which CMK was used?
olivia: logs show arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:111222:key/aa11bb22. partner CI printed the unencrypted data key in a debug step. assume exfiltration.
selena: immediate steps: 1) make artifact storage private (partner says done) 2) revoke partner decrypt role sessions 3) run a canary re-encrypt + restore test before broad rotate.
ops-oncall: I locked the artifact bucket and created an object-level retention policy to avoid re-publication. also kicked token revoke for the partner role.
sec-bot: Incident created: #INC-2026-9998 47. severity: high -> medium after containment. assigned eng-security + infra-oncall.
ryan: plan: temporarily deny decrypt on the CMK, re-encrypt affected objects to a new CMK, allow partner a short-lived decrypt role scoped to OIDC and IP, then rotate alias on their config.
selena: add KMS conditions `kms:EncryptionContext:env=partner_ci` and `aws:RequestTag/rotation=inc-9998` for the re-encrypt window. that prevents leaked ciphertexts from being used elsewhere.
olivia: canary timeline: partner available at +40m. we'll re-encrypt one object and have them do a restore. if successful, roll remaining objects.
ops-oncall: revoke done. sec-bot logged action.
ryan: re-encrypt command example: `aws kms re-encrypt --ciphertext-blob fileb://obj.enc --destination-key-id alias/rotated-inc9998 > obj.rewrapped` - test decrypt locally first.
selena: also enable CloudTrail export and set an alarm for Decrypt calls from non-whitelisted IPs. preserve logs in immutable bucket.
olivia: post-mortem items: require partner CI sanitization (redact secrets), pre-commit check to block printing keys, migrate partner to Vault transit or KMS grants for ephemeral data keys.
ops-oncall: canary re-encrypt done; partner validated restore and checksum matched. proceeding with bulk re-encrypt now.
sec-bot: Incident update: severity lowered to low after canary success and token revoke. monitoring for 24h.
olivia: follow-ups assigned: ops-oncall -> finish re-encrypt + rotate alias; ryan -> PR for CMK policy with `RequestTag` condition; selena -> partner disclosure draft and migration plan to Vault transit.
ryan: note: add condition requiring `aws:PrincipalTag/role=partner_ci` for decrypts to reduce blast radius if keys leak again.
olivia: thanks team. we'll collect CloudTrail export and attach artifact to the incident ticket. closing loop after partner postmortem in 48h. :+1:
